停用将对所选用户禁用应用，保留应用数据；可通过启用恢复。适用于不支持暂停的 An: Disable turns off the apps for the selected user while preserving their data. Enable restores them. Use this on Android TVs that do not support suspension.
启用将恢复所选用户已停用的应用，不会解除暂停状态。: Enable restores disabled apps for the selected user. It does not clear suspension.
禁止会先尝试暂停应用；设备不支持时自动改为停用。恢复会按应用状态解除暂停或重新启: Block first tries suspension, then disables the app if the device does not support it. Restore clears suspension or re-enables the app as needed, preserving app data.
